findings.title: An id lookup can hit the wrong task when a title looks like an id
findings.why: `find` looks the key up as an id first (`tasks.get(key)`) and only then by title. Ids have the form `task-N`. If the user adds a task titled `task-2` while a different task has id `task-2`, then `complete('task-2')`, `remove('task-2')` and the other calls that take a title act on the task with that id, not the one with that title. The title the user typed is never reached. The change does not say which of the two wins.

findings.title: Rejected duplicates still use up an id
findings.why: `++issued` runs before the duplicate-title check. A rejected add (for example from a bulk import) still advances the counter, so ids skip numbers. Ids stay unique, so nothing breaks.

findings.title: Plan and task documents are still the unfilled scaffold
findings.why: The three plan files (1-2, 1-3, 1-4) contain only the template placeholder comment, with `element` and `parent` empty. `task-001-unique-task-ids-and-get-id.md` keeps the scaffold comment above its body, and tasks 002 to 004 do not.
